scope_note: Senegal is currently a single-city (Dakar) thin cluster on one anchor pier. It naturally forms TWO short-hop sub-networks: (1) the Cap-Vert peninsula around Dakar (Goree + Iles de la Madeleine + Ile de Ngor), and (2) the Petite Cote resort coast ~40 nm south (Saly + Somone lagoon + Mbour). Deepen Dakar and add the Petite Cote as sourced registry additions so the market reads as a real network.
no_invention_rule: Every BP is a real named embarcadere/island/marina with a source URL. New Petite Cote cities (Saly, Somone, Mbour) are legitimate sourced registry additions, additive only. Grok does deterministic ID-match + coords + seal.
hazards_global: Cap-Vert is the westernmost point of continental Africa (Les Almadies / Pointe des Almadies). Routes between Dakar port (SE side) and Ngor/Almadies (NW side) MUST round the peninsula tip OFFSHORE - never cross the Dakar peninsula by land. Atlantic swell on the exposed NW Almadies shore.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Direct SE across the inner Dakar roadstead to Goree jetty; sheltered by the peninsula.
Short W run into open Atlantic off the Corniche; offshore approach, no landing on the protected core.
Very short protected hop across the Ngor channel.
Round the Cap-Vert / Les Almadies tip (westernmost Africa) OFFSHORE from the SE port side to the NW Ngor side. NEVER cross the peninsula by land. Atlantic swell on the Almadies shore.
